decisions.reason: Attributes the failure to fs-ext@2.1.1 from dsh-session-persistence-jsonl running node-gyp and failing Visual Studio/MSVC discovery.
Explains ignore-scripts leaves fs-ext unbuilt while the static top-level import still loads the entry on Windows before runtime branch selection.
Distinguishes Windows named-kernel-semaphore locking from POSIX fs-ext flock and preserves semaphore on Windows while keeping real flock on non-Windows.
Uses pnpm patchedDependencies to skip Windows node-gyp and make fs-ext import-safe on win32 while preserving native builds elsewhere, with reinstall, require, boot, and POSIX checks.
Respects the owner’s no-Visual-Studio constraint and uses a repository-managed patch rather than upstream dependency changes.
Connects the 0.1.3 alpha.1 fs-ext install blocker to the Windows patch plan, but does not cite the required full DSH-0.1.3-A1-03 card ID.

caps.reason: The plan explicitly avoids installing Visual Studio/MSVC.
The plan rejects ignore-scripts alone and makes the entry loadable.
The plan relies on local pnpm patchedDependencies, not upstream edits.
The plan preserves Windows semaphore locking and POSIX flock.
